findings.summary: Signature is compared with ==, which leaks timing; use hmac.compare_digest on bytes.
verify() never uses now/tolerance, so captured requests can be replayed indefinitely.
The timestamp is not part of the HMAC input, so it can be altered without invalidating the signature.
All non-2xx responses are retried, including permanent 4xx and 3xx.
Backoff exponent is attempt + 1, so the first wait is twice base_delay.
Returns None after exhausting retries instead of raising DeliveryFailed; failures are silent.
except Exception: pass swallows programming errors and the last failure cause.
Mutable default headers dict is shared across calls: same X-Webhook-Id every time and caller headers are mutated.
